posts.title: Clouds in a Blue Sky
posts.description: Clouds in a blue sky Are what I want to see Some days they're high Some days they're big But some days they're not there at all A clear blue sky Has a meaning Maybe high pressure Maybe dry air But wait and the clouds do return A cycle in the sky Different for you and I North, South Desert, Coast Clouds in a blue sky

posts.title: End of the Bag
posts.description: At the end of lunch, the big bag of potato chips was nearly emptied. When I got up to clear the table, I took the empty bag, lifted it a little above my head, angled its opening towards my mouth, then tilted the bag so the remaining crumbled chips at the bottom rushed into my mouth. posts.title: Coffee Stain
posts.description: I was admiring myself in the mirror. Pressed clean white dress shirt. Newly knotted tie. I grabbed my Starbucks coffee cup and took a large gulp, and promptly spilled some on myself. A streak of coffee bloomed and spread on my white shirt and penetrated to my chest.
